def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [np.array([s == l for s in feats.stratum], float) for l in labs[1:]])
    R = np.corrcoef(X.T); R = np.nan_to_num(R)

    def ll(cols):
        Z = np.column_stack([S] + [c for c in cols]) if cols else S
        b = np.zeros(Z.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            eta = np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30); mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta)); w = mu * (1 - mu) + 1e-9
            H = Z.T @ (Z * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(Z.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, Z.T @ (y - mu)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7: break
        eta = np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30)
        return float(np.sum(y * eta - np.log1p(np.exp(eta))))

    col = lambda j: X[:, j]
    def LLs(sel): return ll([col(j) for j in sel])
    sel = []; base = LLs(sel)
    gates = [0.05 / p, 0.02 / p]
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        best = None
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(R[j, k]) >= 0.6 for k in sel): continue
            g = 2 * (LLs(sel + [j]) - base)
            if best is None or g > best[0]: best = (g, j)
        if best is None: break
        a = gates[min(len(sel), len(gates) - 1)]
        if stats.chi2.sf(best[0], 1) > a: break
        j = best[1]
        rest = sel[:]; lr = LLs(rest)
        clus = [k for k in range(p) if abs(R[j, k]) >= 0.6 and k not in sel and not any(abs(R[k, m]) >= 0.6 for m in sel)]
        if len(clus) > 1:
            lls = {k: LLs(rest + [k]) for k in clus}
            top = max(lls.values())
            cand = [k for k in clus if lls[k] >= top - 2]
            def sg(k):
                return sum(max(0.0, LLs(rest + [k, m]) - lls[k]) for m in clus if m != k)
            j = min(cand, key=sg)
        sel.append(j); base = LLs(sel)
    changed = True
    while changed and sel:
        changed = False
        for j in sel:
            others = [k for k in sel if k != j]
            if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (base - LLs(others)), 1) > 0.02 / p:
                sel = others; base = LLs(sel); changed = True; break
    # product screen over all pairs + squares (score prescreen, then LR)
    eta0 = None
    Z0 = np.column_stack([S] + [col(j) for j in sel]) if sel else S
    b = np.linalg.lstsq(Z0, y, rcond=None)[0]
    mu = np.clip(Z0 @ b, 0.02, 0.98); r = y - mu
    pairs = [(a, c) for a in range(p) for c in range(a, p)]
    sc = []
    for a, c in pairs:
        q = X[:, a] * X[:, c]; q = q - q.mean()
        sc.append((q @ r) ** 2 / (q @ q + 1e-9))
    order = np.argsort(sc)[::-1][:15]
    prods = []; m = len(pairs)
    for i in order:
        a, c = pairs[i]
        mains = sorted(set(sel) | {a, c})
        Lm = LLs(mains)
        Lp = ll([col(k) for k in mains] + [X[:, a] * X[:, c]] + [X[:, x] * X[:, z] for x, z in prods])
        Lq = ll([col(k) for k in mains] + [X[:, x] * X[:, z] for x, z in prods])
        if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (Lp - Lq), 1) < 0.01 / m and len(prods) < 2:
            prods.append((a, c))
    drivers = list(sel)
    for a, c in prods:
        for k in (a, c):
            if k not in drivers and len(drivers) < MAX_DRIVERS: drivers.append(k)
    cols = sorted(set(drivers))
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drivers), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in cols),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[c]) for a, c in prods), loadings={})
